why.substance: the independent cold spec-judge (twice, fresh each time) holds that rules 2 (non-author evidence for a rule-level decision) and 3 (a new/revived rule stated abstractly + ablation-tested) are NOT instrument-scoped: as written, and as the ratified strategy states them (seq6: 'any measurement offered as grounds for a rule-level decision (drop, adopt, threshold-set)'), they are general rule-authoring/landing standards. Homing them on the impl-producer node conflicts with that node's own contract ('never edit the contract', 'does not set its own bar'). Only rule 1 (mutation-sweep-first for an instrument subject) belongs on impl-producer.
